## Type of report

<!-- Tick what applies by changing [ ] to [x]. -->

- [ ] 🐞 **Site bug**: something doesn't work, such as a link, diagram, menu or the theme toggle
- [ ] ✏️ **Content issue**: something in the notes is wrong, unclear or missing
- [ ] 🕰️ **Outdated content**: a product, feature or exam objective has changed
- [ ] 📱 **Device issue**: the problem only appears on a certain device, browser or screen size, or in print
